name: qlrisk_price_overnight_index_swap
title: Price a OvernightIndexSwap
description:
Price one Overnight Index Swap - floating leg tied to overnight rate (qlrisk OvernightIndexSwap): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), fixed_rate_pct* (percent, 3 = 3%), overnight_index (see the schema's list; default SOFR), pay_fixed (default true), payment_frequency (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly/weekly/daily/at maturity; default annual), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4} gives NPV 10,052.92 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
